An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer''' took part in an operation to [[Ambush of Gray Flight|ambush]] [[Stealth Squadron|Gray Flight]]. The ship deployed its [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]], trapping the flight. The Rebel fighters then destroyed eleven [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and turned their attention to the Interdictor. [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] ordered her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] to target their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] on her [[transponder]] as she flew at the ship. She jettisoned the transponder next to the Interdictor, and the torpedoes impacted its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]], disrupting them and allowing the Rebels to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The Interdictor and the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] followed the Rebels to their rendezvous point, but the Rebels had prepared a trap: a [[Power fusion generator|fusion generator]] pulled from Organa's damaged X-wing was targeted by proton torpedoes. The massive explosion heavily damaged the Interdictor and the Rebels were able to escape.

==Behind the scenes==
The Interdictor appears in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[2013]] story arc ''[[Star Wars: In the Shadow of Yavin]]''.
